content.description:
WAVE 17 RULING, from a full trial rebase plus a live prod fold. #10129 ("the fleet verdict reads the deploy rate") is OPEN, CONFLICTING/DIRTY, 2 ahead / 74 behind, merge-base 8ae30b34b. VERDICT: CLOSE IT and re-cut the server half. Its remaining value is its DESIGN, not its diff. Cite charter D185 / D202 / D224 in the close.

WHY NOT LAND IT. Measured, not reasoned:
  - THE REBASE IS 6 CONFLICTED PATHS / 17 HUNKS (cloud_status_cmd.go 9, attention_order_cases.json 3, cloud_status_cmd_test.go 2, attention_order.json 1, client.go 1, semrole.go 1). deploy_ledger.ex, router.ex and deploy_ledger_test.exs auto-merge TEXTUALLY — and that is the trap.
  - THE "CLEAN" ELIXIR AUTO-MERGE IS SEMANTICALLY BROKEN, and worse than D224 says. deploy_ledger_test.exs:2417 calls `DeployLedger.not_attempted_classes/0`, which dr-w16-s3 (#10443) DELETED from main on the stated ground that it had ZERO callers in cloud/lib AND cloud/test. #10129 IS its one caller and was invisible to that census, because the census measured main only. Wave 16's newest guard and wave 10's newest branch shot each other.
  - THAT CRASH MASKS A STILL-LIVE D224 DEFECT. Probe-patching the UndefinedFunctionError away fires the assertion underneath: `BOX_DEPLOY_DISABLED_503 has no agency — the map is not exhaustive`. A builder who "fixes the crash" by deleting `++ not_attempted_classes()` restores green while leaving two classes falling to :ambiguous — D148's forbidden direction.
  - THREE UNDECLARED PUBLICS red wave 16's reachability guard (agency/1, agency_map/0, box_rates/3), and agency_map/0 genuinely has ZERO non-test callers — a dead public, exactly the shape that guard exists to catch.
  - FOUR GO REDS, including TestRunCloudStatusJSON (`row 4 = ok-box/ok/rank 13, want rank 11`), an end-to-end rank assertion no prior ledger names. Plus a tone-hole red that fires at ANY rank: #10129 ships `tone:""` for `unmetered`, which main's guard forbids outright.

AND THE DECISIVE REASON, WHICH IS ABOUT TRUTH NOT MECHANICS. #10129's `box_rates/3` FORKS THE DENOMINATOR and NEVER EMITS LIVE: `rate: rate(failed, failed + live)` against census/3's `rate(failed, volume)` with deferred INCLUDED. On guerrilla over 24h (failed 127 / live 572 / deferred 1,521 / volume 2,220) the three surfaces read: census failure 5.72%, census live 25.77%, #10129 box_rate 18.17%, absorption 68.51%. 18.17% is BELOW the hardcoded `deployFailingFencePct = 20.0`, so guerrilla would render **`ok`** — the exact string the PR was written to abolish — on a box that turned 25.77% of its attempts into a live site. The fence cannot be rescued by moving it: `deployRateOf` reads ONLY `node.Rate.Pct`; Absorption and BoxCaused are decoded and printed as marker prose but can NEVER move the verdict. The one field naming the real problem is decorative by construction. The PR's own 46.28% justification is dead — the daily series crossed 20.0 between 08-06 and 08-07 (90.89 / 88.34 / 87.19 / 87.76 / 86.95 / 84.63 / 83.42 / 60.47 / 3.77), and before the D229 boundary (2026-08-05 21:27:11) the two denominators were EXACTLY equal because zero deferred rows existed.

Landing it unchanged is a leg-1-class reachability win (it hangs the deploy vital on the TEAM-SCOPED `GET /v1/barkparks`, reachable by a read PAT) that delivers the WRONG NUMBER FASTER. That is this epic's own most-committed defect.

THE RE-CUT (a later wave, not wave 17 — it collides with dr-w16-s4/s6 and needs the ladder re-argued at 13 rungs): port `box_rates/3` + the router prefetch + the `BoxDeployRate` decode onto today's main; RE-DENOMINATE on `volume`; EMIT `live` and `live_rate` beside `failed` so the box node shares wave 16's vocabulary; add the two missing @agency classes; and make the rung read `absorption`, or it cannot fire on the actual defect. Also note: `attention_order.json` is DR's (charter D57, "IS OURS, NOT CEDED") and `grep -c attention_order cloud/priv/static/__app.test.mjs` = 0 — the console harness does NOT assert it, contrary to a common belief; its only asserting reader is internal/cli/cloud_status_cmd_test.go:360. But main already carries a live THREE-WAY drift with nothing gating it: Go ladder 11 rungs, fixture 11, app.js ATTENTION_RANK 9.
content.disposition_reason: Adopted by dr-backlog-never-started for ROSTER HEADROOM (charter S-4c). This row is never-started (open, zero criteria met, no claim, no assignee, no evidence), so moving it loses no work; the epic's direct roster was 450 of the seal predicate's ROSTER_PAGE_LIMIT 500, and a full page raises ROSTER-TRUNCATED and destroys the verdict. Disposition stays OPEN: this is still live, claimable work, only its parent_id moved. Nothing was cancelled.
